title: Bundled Domain Credit on Overdue Web Hosting Plans Renewals
content:
### Bundle credit schedule — bundled domain (overdue renewals)

The overdue renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan is reduced by a domain bundle credit for the Domain Registrations registration in status active that names this plan as its bundled hosting plan, because Harborline credits one year of the bundled domain's renewal against the hosting renewal (the domain itself is still billed under Domain Registrations).

**The credit.**

- When the registration's most recent domain renewal charge line is the only renewal charge line on its charge date, carries no refund, and no restore charge line is dated later than it, the credit is that line's amount divided by the years it renewed, as Domain Registrations billed it, rounded half up to the cent.
- Any other active bundled registration — one still in its free first year with no renewal charge yet, one whose most recent renewal charge line was refunded, one restored from redemption after that line, or one with two or more renewal charge lines dated on that most recent charge date — is credited its TLD's renewal price under Domain Registrations.
- A plan with no active bundled registration receives no domain bundle credit, and a cancelled or deleted bundled registration never counts.

| Bundled registration on the Domain Registrations records | Domain bundle credit |
|---|---|
| active; latest renewal line alone on its date, not refunded, no later restore line | that line's amount divided by its years, rounded half up |
| active; no renewal charge yet (free first year) | TLD renewal price |
| active; latest renewal line refunded | TLD renewal price |
| active; restore line dated after the latest renewal line | TLD renewal price |
| active; two or more renewal lines on the latest renewal date | TLD renewal price |
| cancelled or deleted, or none | none |

**Examples (hypothetical amounts).** A latest renewal line of USD 71.85 for 3 years, alone on its date, unrefunded and with no later restore: credit USD 23.95. If a restore line is dated after it, the credit is the TLD's renewal price instead.
